messages:
Marta (Events): T-minus 6. Quick change: roadmap before demos. Mic check in 3 — presenters ready?
ops-bot: reminder: all-hands scheduled at 1768123450
Jules (AV): Seeing intermittent drop on presenter mic channel A. Switching to NDI feed 'presenter-ndi' to avoid replug.
Jules (AV): command: `ndi-switch --to presenter-ndi`
Ken (Eng): Mirroring ingest to ndi endpoint and warming backup recorder: `curl -X POST https://ctl.internal/ingest/switch -d '{"to":"ndi-presenter"}'`
Jules (AV): NDI bound. OBS scene reconnected. Note: captions sourced from fallback on NDI and ~6s delayed.
Marta (Events): Got it. Eve, please mention caption lag and where to file follow-ups in intro.
Eve (CEO): Will do. Roadmap one-liner: "Expanding Dedicated regions, GA targeted Q3."
Nia (Product): Tiny tweak: can we include 'to improve latency & compliance'?
Eve (CEO): Shorten to: "Expanding Dedicated regions (GA targeted Q3) to improve latency & compliance."
Jules (AV): Local iso recording started on backup-recorder-4; preview set to low-res on backup CDN.
ops-bot: alert: recorder-3 removed from rotation at 1768123460
Marta (Events): Mic check — @Alex can you confirm headset B is ready? we heard a faint hum on rehearsal.
Alex (Presenter): Switching to headset B now. FYI docking station can cause hum if laptop on battery.
Ken (Eng): If hum persists we'll mute laptop channel and route headset only. Scheduling archive snapshot at +110s to avoid tail truncation.
Jules (AV): OBS preview green. Captions fallback ~6s lag — please call it out in intros.
Marta (Events): Post-show process: tag action items in #post-allhands with prefix "ACTION:" and include an owner. We'll triage tomorrow.
Nia (Product): I'll post demo follow-ups and slide links in #product immediately after.
Eve (CEO): During Q&A I'll take infra and roadmap Qs. For legal/security followups ask folks to use 'followup: security' or 'followup: legal' in the thread.
ops-bot: recording: backup-recorder-4 started at 1768123475
Jules (AV): GO in 30s. Presenters, final checks?
Alex (Presenter): Headset engaged, levels good, no hum. Ready. :rocket:
